claims.statement: Tom Allen was to go to New Orleans for the Sullivan-Corbett fight, accompanied by his old backer Fred Watkins, Nobby Clark, Chris Lauff and Billy Dacre.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen will be accompanied by his old backer, Fred Watkins,

notes: The article gives the delegation's Sunday departure, not a day for Allen's party specifically. Most of the page is about other St. Louis men.
